{{Top|leg}}
An '''ufflor officer''' was a high-ranking member of an [[Ugnaught/Legends|Ugnaught]] tribe elected by the members of the tribe to represent their people in the [[Parliament of Guilds]] on [[Cloud City/Legends|Cloud City]].<ref name="GG2">''[[Galaxy Guide 2: Yavin and Bespin]]''</ref> [[Ugnor]] was appointed [[Ufflor of Ufflors]] to speak as a single voice for the [[Irden]], [[Botrut]], and [[Isced]] tribes.<ref name="ActionTidings1">{{Wizards|url=default.asp?x=starwars/article/sw20040930bespin1|series=Bespin: Action Tidings|text=Part 1: Live From the Surface}}</ref> Working with [[Baron Administrator/Legends|Baron]] [[Ecclessis Figg/Legends|Ecclessis Figg]], Ugnor and the ufflors started the [[Ugnaught Mechanics Union]].<ref name="ActionTidings2">{{Wizards|url=default.asp?x=starwars/article/sw20041007bespin2|series=Bespin: Action Tidings|text=Part 2: That Den o' Human Iniquity}}</ref>
